title: A backlog.py done piped into another command is recorded as a done work row although a refused done exits non-zero inside the pipe
goal: ql_capture.work_action returns no action for a command that pipes backlog.py done into another command (done ID | tail), because the success event carries the last command's exit code and a refused done would be recorded as done; the rule is written in the Failures part of kb/_self/querylog.md; found in the review of SP-fvztfmtm

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_capture; sys.exit(0 if ql_capture.work_action('python3 _tools/backlog.py done TK-aaaaaaaa | tail -3') is None else 1)

gates.question: Does the pipe rule in ql_capture.work_action cover claim and release as well as done?
